newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ yields close higher in very subdued market.
newsitem.headline: NZ yields close higher in very subdued market.

text.p: * NZ yields close higher but off highs
* 90-day bill since stuck in 9.85-00 pct range.
* Cash at 9.90 pct vs 9.90 pct on Thursday's close
New Zealand bond yields closed higher in a very subdued session on Friday but they ended off their highs.
Dealers said flows were minimal and range trading appeared the likely order of the day next week.
The 90-day bank bills closed at 9.95 percent, off their 9.98 high. High cash remains an inhibiting factor, making it hard for short rates to rally.
Bond yields were marked five basis points higher at the opening after U.S. treasuries weakened by a similar amount overnight.
Sentiment in the U.S. had turned more bearish with a feeling the next move by the Fed will be a tightening.
Some dealers suspect the market is in a hiatus ahead of the September 13 Reserve Bank projections and the October 12 election.
However, impetus may be injected into the market by political opinion polls due to be published by the television networks on Monday.
A further fall in support for the ruling conservative National Party may bring about selling by the nervous nellies, a dealer said. -- Simon Louisson 64 4 4734 746
